concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-risk-and-security-compliance-prohibited-transactions]] - 2026-09-16 collected Braintree prohibited-transactions guidance covering regulator and sanctions scope, possible BIN-linked processing failure, processing-bank decline and funding-bank settlement prevention, with jurisdiction, counterparty and change-over-time qualifications; historical provider guidance, not current law, a complete prohibited list, merchant approval, or proof of an individual authorization, decline, settlement block or notification
warnings: The page is historical Braintree guidance and must not be treated as current law, a complete restricted-country or prohibited-party list, or legal advice.
Modal bank-outcome wording does not establish merchant approval or prove an individual authorization, decline, settlement block, funding result, or notification.
